High level description
•
A square Shopee-style e-commerce hero image for the ZenFit Non-Slip TPE Yoga Mat, with a midnight blue mat and rose pink second mat arranged diagonally alongside a mesh bag and strap, surrounded by floating promotional badges in red-orange, yellow-gold, and teal-green on a clean off-white background.
Compositional deconstruction
•
Background: Clean soft off-white seamless studio backdrop with a very subtle radial vignette drawing focus to center. Bright even studio lighting with neutral cool-toned white balance, crisp soft drop shadows grounding the product cluster on the surface. Edge-to-edge full-bleed composition with no margins.

Desc: Midnight blue yoga mat unrolled flat at a slight three-quarter angle, dominating the middle of the frame. Dual-sided textured surface with a subtle pebbled grip pattern visible across the top face. Rolled edge on the right side showing the 6mm thickness profile in cross-section.
